traces.description: Inspector cleanly presents empty/disabled state when no chord event is selected.
Spelled degrees, pitch classes, root, quality, and omissions accurately reflect chord structure.
Auto, Manual, and Frozen voicings expose exact spelled pitches, MIDI numbers, and families.
Guide tones (3rd & 7th), tensions, scale suggestions, and Roman numeral analyses are disclosed.
Voice leading paths, interval semitones, and common tone metrics are computed in context.
Displayed chord alterations correctly update spelled degrees and synthesized voicing notes.
Custom / unrecognized chords preserve raw user input without being overwritten by guesses.
Piano visualizer accurately renders 88-key layout, flats/sharps, octave tags, and accessible names.
Voicing mode transitions preserve notes, require confirmation when destructive, and reject unisons.
User annotations are strictly sanitized against unsafe HTML markup and bounded to 500 code points.
Audio preview sounds via real X1 generation without mutating playhead, selection, or document.
